rows.en:
(Looks like we somehow managed to wipe out
the Vajra.)
(But the damage is way too heavy...)

(In a situation like this, what are we
supposed to do...?)

(The journey of our Frontier fleet
is finally coming to an end...)

Those monsters have made us suffer bitterly
time and again, and the Frontier fleet
is now in a desperate situation...

But at last, we have located those insects'
home world! We must wipe them out
and survive, whatever the cost!

Our objective: break the Vajra defense net,
defeat the Queen at its core, and meanwhile land
Island 1 on the planet to make it our new home!

May the voice of the Galactic Fairy, Sheryl Nome,
lead us to victory!
Good luck to you all!!

(This is going to be the final battle with the
Vajra. There's no way I can lose...!)

Oh, hey, Alto...
Where are you going right before the sortie?

I've got something important to take care of...
Go on ahead. I'll catch up soon.
(Going to see Sheryl, huh...)
rows.notes: Subject (Alto) implied by 'going to'; Japanese is just 'Sheryl's place, huh'.

rows.en: Luca, don't you want to go see Nanase?
No, I've already been to see her...

Nanase-san...
I'll protect you, no matter what.
Even if it costs me my life...

(Alto and Luca...
Everyone on Frontier is staking everything
on this battle...)
(That's right, and so am I...!)

This is the final battle with the Vajra!
All of you, make damn sure you come back alive!
Let's gooooooo, you lot!!
(We're going to survive this, no matter what!)

(The journey of our Frontier fleet
is finally coming to an end...)

(This is going to be the final battle with the
Vajra. There's no way I can lose...!)

Oh, Saotome-kun...
Where are you going right before the sortie?
(Going to see Sheryl-san, huh...)
Luca-kun, don't you want to go see Nanase?

(Saotome-kun and Luca-kun...
Everyone on Frontier is staking everything
on this battle...)
(That's right, and so am I...!)

(We're going to make it out alive,
no matter what!)

(That was a close call, but it looks like
Alto settled things.)

(Now we've put a stop to Grace's ambition
to rule the galaxy by using Ranka
and the Vajra!)
(All right! Looks like Alto settled things.)

(Thanks to the "Super Dimension Cinderella" and
the "Galactic Fairy," we were able to win.)
rows.notes: Same as the finished twins c02439 / c02446.

rows.en:
(That was a close call, but it looks like
Saotome-kun settled things.)

(Now we've put a stop to Grace's ambition
to rule the galaxy by using Ranka-chan
and the Vajra!)

(All right! Looks like Saotome-kun
settled things.)
Alto!! What was that performance just now!?

What's the problem...
The audience loved it.

Your one-man show nearly caused
a major accident!

Nobody got hurt.
So what's the big deal...
Alto!!

Calm down, you two.
The concert isn't over yet.

Luca's right.
You're both getting way too worked u...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (interrupted by the explosion).

rows.en: Let's go, Luca.
H-hey! Michael, Luca!
rows.notes: Alto uses the full name Mihaeru here: 'Michael'.

rows.en: What the hell is going on...

(Where did Michel and the others go
in an emergency like this...?)

(...No use worrying about it.
I have to follow the evacuation alert
and get to a shelter!)

(I somehow made it safely to the shelter,
but sure enough, everyone here looks
anxious too...)

(If there were explosions, that means
something attacked Frontier, right?)
(Why... Why would anything attack Frontier...)

(Okay, it's been a good while since the
explosions stopped. I'll go take a look outside.)

(The city's been wrecked...
This... this can't be happening......!)
(Alto!?)
Alto! What are you doing in a place like this!?

\p...
So you're okay...

Hey! Are you all right, Alto?
What on earth happened to Frontier!?
What...

Something like a giant bug
suddenly appeared on Island 1...

An S.M.S. machine showed up chasing it,
but that pilot, to protect us...
...I'm not the one who deserves thanks......!
H-hey... Alto!

(What's up with Alto?
He looked like he was really hurting...)
(What in the world happened to Frontier...?)

Luca-kun's right.
You're both getting way too worked u...

(Where did Michel-kun and the others go
in an emergency like this...?)

(...No use worrying about it.
I have to follow the evacuation alert
and get to a shelter!)

(I somehow made it safely to the shelter,
but sure enough, everyone here looks
anxious too...)

(If there were explosions, that means
something attacked Frontier, right?)
(Saotome-kun!?)

Saotome-kun! What are you doing in a place
like this!?

Hey! Are you all right, Saotome-kun?
What on earth happened to Frontier!?
What...
H-hey... Saotome-kun!

(What's up with Saotome-kun?
He looked like he was really hurting...)
(What in the world happened to Frontier...?)

uncertain: c21008: the S.M.S. pilot who protected Alto is kept as 'that pilot' (gender not stated in the scene).
c20968: Gary's battle cry 'omaera, iku zooo' as 'Let's gooooooo, you lot!!'.
